claim.quote: We find an average background of 1.39 $\pm$ 0.02 counts/day/kg/keV in the region of interest and a spectrum consistent with data previously acquired in the PoP setup, where the external veto background suppression was in place.

key_value.note: Exposure of the PoP-dry data set.
key_value.quote: almost one year of data taking (891 kgxdays exposure)

name: Performance of the SABRE detector module in a purely passive shielding

summary.plain: Almost a year of data (891 kg days) from the same crystal in a plain passive shield, with no liquid-scintillator veto, gave a background of 1.39 counts/day/kg/keV in the 1-6 keV region, much as with the veto. This allows SABRE North to be built without a liquid-scintillator veto.
summary.technical: NaI-33 in the PoP-dry set-up (17 March 2021 - 25 February 2022): 1.39 +- 0.02 cpd/kg/keV in 1-6 keV after a boosted-decision-tree noise rejection keeping >90% efficiency; 210Pb, partly in the PTFE reflector, dominates (Eur. Phys. J. C 82, 1158).

title: Performance of the SABRE detector module in a purely passive shielding
why_it_matters: The authors use it to design the passive shielding of the SABRE North physics phase.
